instructions: Identifiers contain 1..128 characters. Other text fields contain 1..1024 unless their schema specifies a different bound. Use swarm_sync to resume. Assign work with a stable command ID; retry uncertain mutations with the same ID. Fetch leases messages; acknowledge only after processing. Task ownership requires the returned attempt ID and fence. Wait timeouts never cancel work.

tools.name: swarm_sync
tools.description: Bootstrap once; resume with an event cursor for targeted deltas.

tools.name: swarm_find
tools.description: Find scoped peers or task summaries; use taskId for details.

tools.name: swarm_assign
tools.description: Create work; routing dispatches via owner policy. Reassign with intentId and expectedVersion.

tools.name: swarm_task
tools.description: Manage ownership/progress; finish with evidence/limitations. Cancel dispatch with intentId.

tools.name: swarm_send
tools.description: Send a typed peer message; assign work with swarm_assign.

tools.name: swarm_inbox
tools.description: Fetch leases one message. Ack only after processing; reject with a reason for retry.

tools.name: swarm_wait
tools.description: Wait for completion; timeout returns a resumable reference.

tools.name: swarm_context
tools.description: Read or mutate versioned shared state; set/delete require expectedVersion.

tools.name: swarm_evidence
tools.description: Capture worktree files or record findings with provenance; read bytes via artifact URI.
